option_relations.rationale: Acute Intestinal Obstruction is a broader category that includes Gallstone ileus as a specific type of intestinal obstruction.
Intestinal ischemia can be a complication of any intestinal obstruction, including gallstone ileus, if the obstruction leads to compromised blood supply.
Gastric band erosion with migration to jejunum causing intestinal obstruction and jejunal perforation is a distinct condition with a different etiology than gallstone ileus.

Small Bowel Obstruction is a broader category that includes Gallstone ileus as a specific type of small bowel obstruction. The 'Post-bariatric Surgery Adhesion/Stricture' part of the option describes a different etiology for small bowel obstruction than gallstone ileus.
